title: Software Update Postflight contract
description: P0-07 / §42. The fail-closed POSTFLIGHT gate that MUST pass after any software WRITE: 更新后必须重新验证真实安装位置. It re-reads the real BEFORE/AFTER install facts and proves the update did not silently relocate, shrink, or re-seed a C-drive default root (DSH 2026-09-20 recurrence scenarios: launcher .lnk reset to LOCALAPPDATA, official resources\app code tree emptied 45k->0, frozen DSH_HOME[HKCU] making the process fall back to C:\Users\ALEX\.dsh). Checks are fail-closed: any violation -> overall FAIL; missing/unknown facts -> UNVERIFIED, which keeps overall at PENDING and never fabricates a PASS.

before.description: Structured BEFORE snapshot facts (install_root, version, launcher_targets, data_root, ...). Open object: adapters supply the discovery-layer facts; the gate consumes a closed subset.

after.description: Structured AFTER snapshot facts (install_root, version, launcher_targets, data_root, c_drive_residue, code_tree_files, asar_residue, uninstaller, runtime_health).

location_readback_passed.description: True only when before.install_root == after.install_root with both roots present (a plain update must NOT move the install root; §18/§42). Computed by reusing software_installation_identity.location_readback — no second engine (§22).
